usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/grok-video/generate with JSON body {prompt, duration, resolution, aspect_ratio} (x402 pay ~$0.15 USDC on Base); returns 200 {success, jobId, status:"pending"}. Then GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX-signed, FREE) to poll until status="complete".
usage.outputShape: POST: body.jobId, body.status="pending". Poll GET body.status ("pending"->"complete"), body.progress (0-100), and on completion body.result.videoUrl (mp4) + body.result.thumbnailUrl (jpg). Echoed inputs at body.input.
quirks: Registry CALL url (stablestudio.dev) is a DIFFERENT, cleaner deployment than the older existingUsage entry (blockrun.ai) — use stablestudio.dev.
Async two-step: POST charges ~$0.15 once and returns a pending jobId (NOT the video). You must poll a separate endpoint to get the result.

Poll URL is https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (the jobId from the POST response). It returns 402 with error 'SIWX authentication required' (amount=0, accepts:[]) — polling is FREE but requires a wallet SIWX signature (use an x402/SIWX-capable client; qa-pay --siwx works). It is NOT pay-per-poll, so no per-poll charge.

POST body requires ALL FOUR fields: prompt, duration (enum '3'/'6'/'9'/'12'/'15', strings not ints), resolution ('480p'/'720p'), aspect_ratio ('1:1'/'16:9'/'9:16'/'4:3'/'3:4'/'3:2'/'2:3'). additionalProperties:false. Optional 'image' (uri) for image-to-video.
Real price observed $0.15 USDC on Base (amount 300000), matches registry surface ($0.150) — the existingUsage $0.42 figure was the blockrun.ai deployment, not this one.
Generation is fast: '3'-second 480p clip completed in ~28s. Larger duration/resolution likely slower.
POST also offered a Solana payment rail in accepts[]; Base USDC used here.
usage.guide: POST to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/grok-video/generate via an x402 client (~$0.15 USDC on Base) with JSON {"prompt":"...","duration":"3","resolution":"480p","aspect_ratio":"1:1"} — all four fields are required and values are strings. You get back {jobId, status:"pending"}; this is async, the video is not in this response. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIWX-signed request (free, no per-poll charge) every ~10-30s until body.status==="complete", then read the mp4 at body.result.videoUrl (and thumbnail at body.result.thumbnailUrl). A 3s/480p clip finishes in roughly 30s.
